images.title: Rocket launches by organisation
images.purpose: Show the clustered horizontal bar graph of rocket launches in 2021, 2022 and 2023 that the questions are read from.
images.composition: A horizontal clustered bar graph on a dark navy background, organisation names down the left, the launch count scale along the bottom, a legend on the right.
exact_structure: A horizontal axis from 0 to 100 with numbered gridlines at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 (scale 1 unit = 20 rockets).
Ten organisation rows from top to bottom, each with three thin bars: dark blue for 2021, mid blue for 2022, near white for 2023.
United Launch Alliance: about 5, 8 and 3 launches.
A legend on the right: three small squares labelled 2021, 2022 and 2023.
No values are printed on the bars; students estimate them from the gridlines.
rejection: a scale not in steps of 20
images.takeaway: Bar lengths are read against the scale, so small counts can only be estimated.
images.description: A clustered bar graph of rocket launches by ten organisations in 2021, 2022 and 2023, scale 1 unit = 20 rockets.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Students estimate; accept readings within about 2 of the stated values.

image_decisions.why: All the questions are read from the rocket launch graph.
